windows_companion.instructions: On real supported Windows: extracted AeroScience.exe launches and automatically opens its dashboard, without a terminal/server command.

offline_archive_export.instructions: With MSFS closed: the selected local archive and saved mission details/export are accessible; existing history remains intact.

toolbar_install_load.instructions: With MSFS closed: graphical Settings installs the included genuine SDK package; after starting MSFS its toolbar opens.

simconnect_live.instructions: In MSFS: the loaded aircraft and fresh actual SimConnect telemetry appear; no generated data is substituted.

live_mission_smoke.instructions: Start and end a short actual flight mission, inspect its recorded samples and confirm retained history after restarting AeroScience.

runtime_dependencies.instructions: On real Windows: included licensed native runtime loads with required exports; supported graphical Visual C++ prerequisites work without SDK/manual DLL copying.

release_contents.instructions: Extract the candidate ZIP, test that extracted app, verify checksum and inspect that package/runtime are complete and no personal data is included.
